blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Residents living near an unstable hillside in Barangay Pulangbato may need to evacuate their homes as Cebu City assesses the risk of further landslides after a rain-triggered collapse buried four family members on Friday, October 9. As of this writing, a five-year-old child and a six-year-old child were confirmed dead, while a 38-year-old woman was rescued and brought to a hospital. Search and rescue operations continue for the remaining victim, a 60-year-old, amid shifting ground, which puts rescuers at risk.
